meta.name: data-statistical-analysis
meta.description: Aplica métodos estatísticos incluindo estatísticas descritivas, análise de tendências, detecção de outliers e testes de hipótese para dados do workspace. Use quando analisar distribuições de MRR/churn, testar se uma mudança de produto moveu métricas, detectar anomalias em instâncias do Licensing, calcular correlações, ou interpretar resultados estatísticos. Execução local via Python.

copy.tagline: 对工作区数据执行描述统计、趋势分析、异常检测和假设检验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要分析业务数据分布、检验产品变更效果或发现异常值
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to analyze business data distributions, test product change effects, or detect outliers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能对工作区数据（如 MRR、用户流失）进行描述性统计、趋势分析、异常检测和假设检验，并编写 Python 代码在本地执行。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析 MRR/流失分布、测试产品变更是否影响指标，或检测实例异常时触发。

say.text: 分析上个月的 MRR 分布情况
say.note: 将输出描述统计和图表

say.text: 检测最近一周的实例异常
say.note: 会标记异常天数并解释原因

say.text: 新版转化率有显著提升吗？
say.note: 执行假设检验并报告 p 值

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform descriptive statistics, trend analysis, outlier detection, and hypothesis testing on workspace data (e.g., MRR, churn, Licensing instances) by writing and running Python code locally.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests analysis of MRR/churn distributions, testing if a product change moved metrics, detecting anomalies in instances, or interpreting statistical results.

say_en.text: Analyze the MRR distribution for last month.
Detect anomalies in last week's instances.
Did the new version significantly improve conversion?
say_en.note: Runs hypothesis test and reports p-value.
